description: Synthetic, written by hand for #2303: never a real ride.
A rider riding RAMP_TEST against a threshold of 250 W: 480 s of warm-up, then one-minute steps from 150 W rising by 15 W (0.6 of threshold, up 0.06 a step).
They hold eleven steps, the last at 300 W, fail 20 s into the 315 W step and stall, then spin easy in the cool-down.
power is run-length, [watts, seconds], with null for a dropout. The best minute of the effort is the 300 W step.
